note: Starter mapping from NVIDIA XID codes and AMD amdgpu fault classes to SLA actions. Review it against the vendor documentation for your driver version and against the contract before using it for SLA decisions. node_down opens an incident that stays open until an up event arrives from a repair or health-check integration. observe records the message without an SLA event.

13.summary: Graphics engine exception; usually caused by the application

31.summary: GPU memory page fault; usually caused by the application

43.summary: GPU stopped processing; usually caused by the application

45.summary: Preemptive cleanup after a process ended

63.summary: Row remapping or page retirement recorded; schedule a GPU reset

64.summary: Row remapping or page retirement failed

79.summary: GPU has fallen off the bus

94.summary: Contained ECC error; restart the application

ras_uncorrectable.summary: Uncorrectable hardware error reported by amdgpu RAS

ras_correctable.summary: Correctable hardware error reported by amdgpu RAS

gpu_reset.summary: GPU reset started; work running on the GPU was lost

ring_timeout.summary: Command ring timed out (a job hung)

page_fault.summary: GPU page fault; usually caused by the application

default.summary: Not in the policy; needs a human decision
